'''Llana''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]], and is also of the [[Black Ajah]].
== History ==
Llana is part of the [[Red Ajah]]'s mission to capture [[Mazrim Taim]]. However, she is also sent by the Black Ajah in order to kidnap Taim before he can be brought to the [[White Tower]] and [[Severing|gentled]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
